infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Seixo uses the microphone only to record voice messages. Recordings are encrypted on your phone before they leave, and nothing is sent unless you send it.

plugins.cameraPermission: Seixo uses the camera to scan a contact's QR code and to take photos you choose to send. Photos are encrypted on your phone before they leave it.

plugins.photosPermission: Seixo only sees the photo you choose to send, never your library. The image is encrypted on your phone before it leaves, without its location or other photo data.
